In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀
Aufgaben
Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien : Gemeinsam mit unseren Account Managern arbeitest du zielgerichtete SEA-Strategien aus und sorgst dafür, dass das volle Werbepotenzial auf Amazon ausgeschöpft wird.
Keywordrecherche & Analyse : Du führst umfassende Keywordrecherchen durch und kümmerst dich um die On- und Offpage-Optimierung, um die Sichtbarkeit der Produkte zu maximieren.
Kampagnenoptimierung : Dein Ziel ist es, das Potenzial der Kampagnen optimal auszuschöpfen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
Datenbasierte Maßnahmen : Du erstellst Analysen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Weiterentwicklung der Kampagnen ab – mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools behältst du den Erfolg stets im Blick.
Reporting : Du erstellst regelmäßige Reportings, um die Ergebnisse der Kampagnen transparent für unsere Kunden darzustellen.
Amazon Seller Central : Du bist versiert im Umgang mit dem Amazon Seller Central und nutzt es zur Steuerung der Werbekampagnen.
PPC-Preisoptimierung : Du optimierst die PPC-Preise basierend auf vorher festgelegten Strategien und sorgst dafür, dass das Budget optimal eingesetzt wird.
Qualifikation
Studium: Du bist immatrikulierte/r Student/in.
Selbstständiges Arbeiten : Du bist in der Lage, eigenständig zu arbeiten und eigenverantwortlich Projekte zu steuern.
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe : Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und Lösungen zu finden.
Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit : Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist kommunikationsstark – sowohl intern als auch im Austausch mit Kunden.
Analytisches Verständnis : Du liebst es, mit Zahlen zu arbeiten und hast ein gutes Verständnis für analytische Zusammenhänge.
Strukturierte Kommunikation : Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert – egal ob schriftlich oder mündlich.
Excel- und PowerPoint : Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint und weißt, wie man diese Tools effektiv einsetzt, um Ergebnisse zu präsentieren und Daten auszuwerten.

Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

Ganzheitliche operative Betreuung: Du bist nicht nur beratend tätig, sondern setzt Kampagnen im Online Marketing (z. B. SEO, Newsletter-Marketing) selbstständig auf, optimierst sie fortlaufend und hältst die Fäden in der Hand. Dabei hast du Spaß daran, dich auch in neue Kanäle einzuarbeiten.

Sport & Wellness : Wir fördern deine Fitness mit einer geförderten Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft.
Volle Mobilität: Mit dem Deutschlandticket bist du bundesweit flexibel und umweltfreundlich unterwegs.

You can work remotely, with the option to use our Amsterdam office, and should be open to occasional travel to our HQ in Hamburg, Germany.

Develop and execute the Dutch & Belgian brand and marketing strategy by aligning global direction with local consumer insights
Define the marketing activation calendar and lead the planning and execution of 360° campaigns across all relevant channels
Help define the local product portfolio focus based on market needs and opportunities
Lead integrated brand campaigns by briefing assets that are brand-compliant and tailored to the Dutch & Belgian audience
Manage agencies to ensure timely, high-quality campaign execution
Track key brand metrics (awareness, equity, engagement) and campaign performance to drive continuous improvement
Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver a consistent and engaging brand experience across all D2C and retail channels
Lead retail media and shopper marketing initiatives with key Dutch & Belgian retailers to ensure strong brand presence online and in-store
Act as the brand guardian for the Netherlands and Belgium, ensuring consistency in tone, messaging, and visual identity
Partner with local Commercial teams and other stakeholders to align marketing with market goals
Monitor competitors, trends, and new market opportunities and derive actionable plan

4–6 years of experience as a Brand or Marketing Manager in consumer goods within FMCG, responsible for 50m+ revenue
Strong expertise in brand building and integrated campaigns including mass media, influencers, and retail media within the Dutch and Belgian market
Hands-on experience in D2C environments, social media (Meta, TikTok), retail media, and shopper marketing
Ability to build impactful and consistent digital consumer journeys
Strong hands-on project management and cross-functional collaboration skills
Strategic, creative, and data-driven mindset with confidence in using digital marketing tools
Fluent in English and Dutch (both written and spoken), ideally also working proficiency in French

We're on a mission
Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.

You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.

Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.
Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.
Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.
From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.
The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.
Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.
Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.
This could be for you if

You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.

You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.

You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

Small business owners didn't start their business to become their own bookkeeper, banker, and collections department. Jobber is changing that, building the financial hub for a $400B home-services market, and Fintech is how we get there.
The future of financial services is embedded, and we're still early. For decades, small businesses ran their finances through a patchwork: a bank for payments, a lender for capital, a spreadsheet for everything else. That's ending. The next generation of financial services won't live at a bank, it'll live inside the software businesses already use to run their day. More and more, vertical SaaS platforms like Jobber won't just help small businesses operate; they'll become their financial hub.
Jobber is building for that world. We already help home service pros get paid faster, secure the capital they need to grow, and see their financial health clearly, and we've only scratched the surface. We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Marketing (Fintech) to own the commercial story that gets us there, as part of our growing Product & Lifecycle Marketing team.
Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists.

With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011, but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

At Jobber, we're not just building software, we're helping home service businesses accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability, and maintain healthy cash flow. Our Product Marketing Fintech team is central to this mission: enabling businesses to get paid faster, secure the capital needed for growth, and gain clarity on their financial health.

This is not a launch-execution role. Reporting to our Senior Director, Product & Lifecycle Marketing, you'll own Marketing-influenced revenue for Jobber's entire Fintech portfolio; adoption, activation, usage, and revenue across payments, financing, and capital are your numbers.

It's a career-defining opportunity to lead the adoption of Fintech in one of the largest remaining B2B markets, partner with the best-of-the-best in the space, and help small businesses succeed while you do it. If you think like a business owner and want to lead a team that moves the needle on revenue, this is the role.

The Marketing Specialist (MarTech Manager) serves as the strategic lead for the Air Force Services (AFS) Non Appropriated Fund (NAF) marketing technology ecosystem, including the enterprise CMS, eCommerce, analytics, and related digital platforms.

Provides governance, product ownership, and enterprise coordination to ensure digital platforms directly support revenue-generating business units and enterprise marketing objectives.

Operates under the administrative and policy oversight of the Marketing Operations Branch Chief, who retains responsibility for enterprise compliance and inherently governmental functions.

Execute responsibilities in collaboration with Strategic Marketing team members, cross-functional AFSVC partners, and contracted vendors to ensure alignment across digital, technical, and operational stakeholders.

Performs platform-level system administration for the enterprise CMS and related MarTech platforms, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, workflow configuration, template and module setup, and management of platform settings that support business operations.

Conducts quality assurance testing, validates vendor releases, troubleshoots functional issues, and coordinates resolution with contracted developers. Implements and maintains digital analytics and tracking configurations to support measurement of customer behavior, digital conversion, and business unit performance.

Configures tagging, dashboards, and reporting tools; validates data accuracy; and provides insights to inform platform enhancements and marketing decision-making.

Owns and manages the security and compliance documentation required for NAF-funded digital platforms, ensuring all system information, technical artifacts, and supporting materials are developed, compiled, and submitted in coordination with technical and cybersecurity stakeholders.

Initiates required compliance actions, tracks progress, routes documentation through appropriate offices, resolves comments, and ensures packages move through the full review and approval lifecycle. Authorization decisions and cybersecurity authority remain with designated enterprise authorities.

Develops, drafts, and compiles documentation required to support digital operations, including governance guidance, platform change packages, technical requirements, SOW inputs, and compliance-related materials. Staff documents through appropriate offices and ensure timely routing, review, and resolution of comments.

Prepare decision briefs and recommendations for the Marketing Operations Branch Chief. Serves as the Product Owner for AFS MarTech platforms, defining the roadmap, requirements, and prioritization of enhancements that improve customer experience, increase digital conversion, and strengthen revenue performance across business units.

Identifies capability needs and modernization opportunities based on analytics, user feedback, and mission requirements. Maintains product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release plans.

Develops and maintains digital governance, including publishing standards, access roles, workflow rules, content lifecycle requirements, and digital compliance practices. Provides guidance to installations and program offices on interpreting and applying governance standards.

Ensure platform requirements remain aligned with enterprise technical and security frameworks in coordination with technical stakeholders. Leads development of Statements of Work (SOWs), technical requirements, and evaluation criteria for MarTech services, and coordinates with Procurement teams for contract execution, renewals, and modifications.

Monitors vendor performance and ensures deliverables meet requirements and support revenue-producing operations. Designs the strategy and framework for the MarTech training program and partners with Marketing Training & Development Manager(s) and the Installation Support Liaison for delivery, onboarding, and field communications.

Ensure installations can effectively use digital platforms to promote programs, drive participation, and support business unit performance. Communicates platform changes, updates, and requirements across the AF MilMark Network.
